premise: Frog says she has a secret trick; Fox and Deer guess jumps and splashes, but her trick is sitting so perfectly still that a fly comes close… then SNAP.
inspiration: The boast undone (Aesop's fables of the braggart), turned inside out: the friends guess big, loud tricks, and the quiet trick wins.
lesson: Being still and patient is a skill worth cheering for.

en-US.title: Frog's Big Trick
en-US.text: {frog:enter} Frog came hopping into the pond. [excited] I have a secret trick! she said. Along trotted {fox:enter} Fox. {fox:face surprised} Is it a giant jump? {frog:wobble} No! Along walked {deer:enter} Deer on his long legs. {deer:face surprised} Is it a big splash? No! Even a little {mushroom:enter} mushroom popped up to see. [curious] My trick needs quiet, said Frog. Very, very quiet. So Deer {deer:live} nibbled the grass without a sound, then lifted his head and flicked his ears. Fox {fox:live} pricked up his ears, closed his eyes and listened… then smiled and swished his tail. [whispers] Something's coming. {sfx:fly} Bzzz… {frog:live hold} A little fly buzzed up. Frog sat perfectly still, eyes on the fly. Closer… closer… {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} SNAP! Out flicked her tongue. Gulp! {all:face surprised} [gasps] That was the trick? {frog:face happy} Frog grinned. The mushroom {mushroom:live} scrunched up her face… ah… ah… ACHOO! A puff of sparkles! {all:face happy} [laughs] And everyone cheered {all:hop} for the stillest trick in the pond.

es-ES.title: El gran truco de Rana
es-ES.text: {frog:enter} Rana llegó saltando a la charca. [excited] ¡Sé hacer un truco secreto!, dijo. Llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro. {fox:face surprised} ¿Es un salto gigante? {frog:wobble} ¡No! Llegó {deer:enter} Ciervo con sus patas largas. {deer:face surprised} ¿Es un chapuzón enorme? ¡No! Hasta una {mushroom:enter} setita asomó para mirar. [curious] Mi truco necesita silencio, dijo Rana. Mucho, mucho silencio. Así que Ciervo {deer:live} mordisqueó la hierba sin hacer ruido, luego levantó la cabeza y movió las orejas. Zorro {fox:live} levantó las orejas, cerró los ojos y escuchó… luego sonrió y meneó la cola. [whispers] Algo viene. {sfx:fly} Bzzz… {frog:live hold} Llegó una mosquita. Rana se quedó quietísima, sin quitarle ojo. Más cerca… más cerca… {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} ¡ZAS! Sacó la lengua larguísima. ¡Glup! {all:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Ese era el truco? {frog:face happy} Rana sonrió. La seta {mushroom:live} arrugó la cara… a… a… ¡ACHÍS! ¡Chispitas por todas partes! {all:face happy} [laughs] Y todos aplaudieron {all:hop} el truco más quieto de la charca.

fly.prompt: a single tiny fly buzzing softly as it comes closer, a small comic bzzz

snap.prompt: a quick soft comic flick of a frog's tongue and a tiny gulp
